Name: Pet Bunny Rabbit
Author: NexusModsUser92384
Description:
Will not work prior to 1.6.

Adds a pet rabbit. Obtain it the same way you would the vanilla cat or dog: by selecting it on the character customization screen and waiting for Marnie to show up at your farm, or purchasing it from Marnie's Ranch after you unlock the option to buy additional pets (will be 40,000g).

It can bring you some gifts at max friendship (in order from most to least common: hay, egg, wool, rabbit's foot). Comes with a config file so you can
[list]
[*]select which of these gifts you do(n't) want the rabbit to be able to bring you.
[*]change the sleeping animation it's using.
[*]stop the rabbit from sleeping on/near your bed or on the rug as often, if it gets in your way too much.
[/list]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is helpful for making these changes, but it is not required.
